findings.obs_text: A negator reaches the regard itself in Gen 4:5, Deu 33:9, 1Sa 1:16, 1Sa 25:25, Job 9:21, Job 34:27, Job 35:13, Job 37:24, Psa 28:5, Isa 5:12, Isa 13:17, Isa 33:8, Lam 4:16, 2Th 3:15 and 2Cor 5:16: the regard is withheld (no regard, regard not, do not regard, regard no more, regard no one). The other qualifiers of these verses reach other words: very (the anger), cruel and wise of other persons.

In Gen 31:15, Isa 29:17 and Rom 2:26 the negator opens a question that expects yes: are we not regarded as foreigners, will not the field be regarded as a forest, will not the uncircumcision be regarded as circumcision.
findings.grounds: Are we not regarded by him as foreigners

findings.obs_text: Where the word is counting as something, the qualifier gives the value counted: forbidden in Lev 19:23, wise in Pro 17:28, good in Jer 24:5, earthen against precious in Lam 4:2, strange in Hos 8:12, greatest in Luk 22:24, rulers in Mar 10:42, worthy of all honor in 1Ti 6:1, faithful in Heb 11:11 and 1Pe 5:12, able in Heb 11:19, greater in Heb 11:26; in 1Ki 10:21 silver is counted as nothing, and in Isa 29:16 the negators reach the maker's work, not the counting.
findings.grounds: considered him faithful who had promised

findings.obs_text: Where the word is attention set on a matter, the qualifiers describe what is considered or the one considering, not the act: Job is blameless and upright in Job 1:8 and Job 2:3, the body is as good as dead in Rom 4:19, the horns are another, little and three in Dan 7:8, the land is of the living in Isa 53:8, the Preacher is wise in Ecc 12:9, the prophets two or three in 1Cor 14:29; in Mat 1:20 and Eze 18:28 the negators reach fear and death.

Where regard is given, the qualifiers name who gives it or what stands against it: in Pro 12:10 righteous names the one whose regard reaches even his animal, set against the cruel mercy of the wicked; in 2Ki 3:14 the oath on the Lord who lives frames Elisha's regard for the king.
findings.grounds: Whoever is righteous has regard for the life of his beast

findings.obs_text: Where the word is a weight or a link, the qualifiers reach the objects or the matter: two bracelets in Gen 24:22, a beautiful cloak, 200 shekels and a bar of 50 in Jos 7:21, a sharp sword in Eze 5:1; in Col 2:16 the negator reaches the passing of judgment and with regard to is a link; in Act 28:22 everywhere reaches the speaking against the sect.
findings.grounds: a bar of gold weighing 50 shekels
